name: Adobe

MTS-1.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — DSA plus CS fundamentals, often easier than other big-tech loops
rounds: HR phone screen (job profile and experience)
Online coding test (in campus and many off-campus drives)
Technical rounds 1–2: DSA and core CS (OS, threads, OOP), puzzles
Managerial round: technical deep-dive and project discussion
Director round: technical questions and motivation
extraTopics: Operating-system concepts (threads, processes, deadlock, mutex, semaphores)
REST/API basics, multithreading, low-level design of everyday systems (e.g. elevator)
MTS-1.notes: Reports describe 4–5 interviews over 1–2 days for MTS-1; older campus loops were one coding round plus three technical interviews.

MTS-2.dsaDepth: Heavy — 2 DSA problems per round, several technical rounds before a director round
rounds: Technical rounds focused on DSA (trie, tree traversal, sorted-array problems) and project depth
Director round (coding, e.g. KMP / Kadane implementation)
extraTopics: Multithreading, async programming, system design of a small system
Team-specific tooling questions (e.g. DevOps / Kubernetes for some teams)
MTS-2.notes: Each round is elimination; reports mention both laptop and paper coding.
